title: Metaform Graph Model
description: A Metaform is a namespace-addressed JSON document. Object keys establish hierarchical namespace addresses directly at the root. A value at any namespace address may be a nested namespace object, a JSON array (ComposedElementLayer), or a scalar. Object keys at any level are overloaded to act as both reserved metadata attributes and dynamic structural paths simultaneously. No universal knowledge-record wrapper, artificial record IDs, or implied semantic array ordering is introduced.

project.description: Project associated with this functional topology.

NamespaceValue.title: Value at a namespace address
NamespaceValue.description: Objects extend the addressed hierarchy or hold structured data. Arrays denote composed element layers; scalars are direct values.

NamespaceNode.title: Namespace branch or receiving element
NamespaceNode.description: Child keys establish further namespace segments; explicit element metadata attributes are reserved alongside them. The same key can be an element metadata field at one location and a namespace segment at another (for example code.registry.role). When present on a receiving element, providers contains its provider-address-keyed relationships.

name.description: The company-specific internal designation or project official terminology.

role.description: The ontological role of this element within the digital typonomy (DE | SE | NE).

op.description: The active goal (why) of the Receiving Entity (RE) that the EF must satisfy. Written as a ASD-STE100 simplified technical english phrase.

ef.description: The mechanism, interface, relationship, or method of the provider that satisfies the op. Formatted strictly in ASD-STE100.

status.description: Mutable value indicating present state of the Receiving Entity (RE), not meant to be a permamant value (e.g., not_built,).

name_length.description: Namespace Address read Backwards, how many segments is the length of the technical name.

ComposedElementLayer.title: Array-valued composed element layer
ComposedElementLayer.description: Any JSON array at any namespace address constitutes a composed element layer. Its members retain their native structure without synthetic integer IDs or semantic ordering.

Providers.title: Receiving element's providers map
Providers.description: An object whose keys are the namespace addresses of providing elements. Each entry is a localized provider record owned by this receiving element. The providing-element address is the key; it is not repeated inside the value object.

ProviderRecord.title: Provider record
ProviderRecord.description: A receiver-owned statement of an operational relationship, mapping a specific provider key to its context-specific interface flow direction, operative purpose, and encounter function.

ice.description: Describe the direction [send|receive|both] of the information flow that fully satisfies the active goal (OP) of the receiving entity (RE) (Not Including the Request).

ifd.description: Describe the direction [send|receive|both] of the information flow that fully satisfies the active goal (OP) of the receiving entity (RE) (Not Including the Request).

op.description: The active goal (why) of the Receiving Entity (RE) that the EF must satisfy. Formatted strictly in ASD-STE100.

ef.description: The mechanism, interface, relationship, or method of the provider that satisfies the op. Formatted strictly in ASD-STE100.
